title: A restored cloud workspace re-runs the repository's setup
body:
WorkerAttemptHost builds its WorkspaceGit without a setup command, so a container lost mid-turn is restored to the last wip snapshot without the repository's [sandbox] setup (dependency installs). image/worker.sh has no entry that runs only repo_setup; add one (e.g. ticks-worker --setup) and wire it as WorkspaceGit.setup.
evidence: harness/src/host/worker-attempt.ts workspaceGit() (no setup field)
